title: Google rolls out new search homepage with AI chat history and no search button
summary: Google search is making it even easier to access AI tools on the search page.
llm_summary: Google has refreshed its search homepage, removing the traditional “Search” button and making the AI‑powered chat bar the focal point. The new layout automatically shows users their past AI chat conversations, letting them pick up where they left off or start fresh with a single tap. The change is meant to streamline access to Google’s generative‑AI features while keeping the classic search
